modules.responsibility: ECS runtime (Cuvara.DOTS.*): simulation groups, modules, provisioning, views, messaging, DI, GameFoundation/GameLogic/Netcode/Prediction/Physics bridges.
rules: Every new file/folder needs its .meta.

Release per Documentation~/RELEASE.md: PR into main, bump package.json and rename [Unreleased] to '## [X.Y.Z] - date' in the tagged commit, compatibility line per moved pin, ### Migration when needed.
Test floors: CI asserts minimum test counts per assembly (assert_test_floors.py) - adding tests may require raising floors, removing tests fails CI.
Define-constrained assemblies: behaviour must hold in all six CI matrix configurations (without/with netcode, core-only, physics, full-stack, gamefoundation).

Game rules (movement, combat, damage, validation, cooldowns, any formula the server must agree with) live only in Shared.GameLogic (server repo, server-realtime) and reach this repo through the com.rpgmmo.shared-gamelogic pin (pin-bump). Never reimplement or copy one here (ADR-10); a missing rule stops this leg.

external.run: CI UnityDots ci.yml (6 configurations) Unity jobs (game-ci, Unity (fact unity-editor-version)) on the PR, or client Editor with a local toggle (human gate client-package-toggle)
external.evidence: Job pass with non-zero executed test count.

check_metas.py reads `git ls-files` and skips ~ folders: stage new files before trusting it, and check Samples~/Tests~ .meta by hand (UnityDots Samples~ has 8, UIToolkit 17 files without .meta today).

extended.evidence: Prints READY or the exact NOT READY reasons; only informs the ready-to-tag hand-off.
extended.trigger: Preparing a release (READY_TO_TAG) - not required for ordinary changes

modules.responsibility: Repository-level files not owned by a module (.gitignore, .gitattributes, .claude/, root docs, editor configs). Routed to factory-core only; no specialised skill.
rules: Repository-level config affects every module: review the diff with the repo owner; .claude/ holds the repo's own agent assets (never overwrite them from Factory).
